info.title: Algohub API
info.description: Phase 1 foundation, Phase 2 identity, Phase 3 Practicum, Phase 4 E-learning and Phase 5 SIAKAD/Inventory. Browser requests use a same-origin SvelteKit proxy forwarding its validated application Origin; sessions are host-bound, HttpOnly, Secure outside local development, and never public-cacheable. Session refresh rotates opaque credentials without extending the original lifetime. Logout revokes the complete SSO family. Supabase tokens are not retained or exposed. Practicum requires ALGOHUB_PRACTICUM_ENABLED=true, E-learning requires ALGOHUB_ELEARNING_ENABLED=true, and SIAKAD/Inventory requires ALGOHUB_SIAKAD_ENABLED=true. All /v1 responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store. Domain mutations require CSRF and scoped Idempotency-Key.

servers.description: Production target; not deployed by this change

tags.name: practicum
tags.description: Owned student assessments. Active mahasiswa assignment, matching scope and explicit activation roster are required; admin hostname is not authorization. Missing/inaccessible individual resources return 404. Non-student lists are empty. Server UTC deadlines are authoritative; Asia/Jakarta display metadata is returned with every attempt. Lists use limit=25 (1..100), offset=0 (0..1000000); no total or cursor is returned, advance by received items until an empty page. Poll/refetch for updates; no public cache, ETag or websocket.

tags.name: practicum-admin
tags.description: Explicit scoped permissions only, with no role bypass. Definition writes require grants covering the whole session definition, not just one class. Activation management, monitoring and grading check full domain/institution/ division/session/class/shift scope. Private references and rubrics are only returned for question.manage authoring or practicum.grade.write review. Monitoring never returns raw answers or source. All mutations are audited without source, answer, access token or provider prompt content.

tags.name: practicum-internal
tags.description: Server-to-server only. Separate ALGOHUB_PRACTICUM_CRON_SECRET, nonempty and at least 32 characters; unconfigured or wrong credentials fail closed before service/database work. Cookie sessions, Origin, CSRF and Idempotency-Key are not used. Reconciliation is bounded, synchronous and safe to repeat.

tags.name: learning
tags.description: E-learning curriculum, interactive code lab, progress, gamification, hints, achievements, leaderboard and Bug Hunt. Requires learning.content.read; completion and Bug Hunt XP rewards are strictly idempotent.

post.description: Requires roster, assignment scope, open activation, token if configured and instructor exam-entry approval for ujian_praktik. Repeated start, even with a new key, returns the existing attempt without extending its deadline. Requires host-bound session, allowed Origin, matching CSRF and Idempotency-Key. post.summary: Run a coding answer through the configured isolated adapter
post.description: Does not save an answer. Durable global/user concurrency and 30 admissions per user/activation/minute; 429 RUNNER_QUOTA_EXCEEDED with Retry-After: 30. In-flight replay returns 409; finished replay returns the persisted result without another execution. Unconfigured provider returns 503; an admitted provider failure is a typed provider_error result. Requires host-bound session, allowed Origin, matching CSRF and Idempotency-Key. Key is scoped to actor/action/resource: same input replays current authoritative state; different input returns 409. PracticumCronBearer.description: Independent server-only cron secret, at least 32 characters; never an identity session or browser credential.

PracticumIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
PracticumIdempotencyKey.description: Stable safe key per actor/action/resource and exact request input; replay returns authoritative state, different input returns 409. First creation may return a one-time access token that replay omits.

PracticumLimit.name: limit
PracticumLimit.description: Maximum returned items after scope/eligibility filtering; no total/cursor metadata.

PracticumOffset.name: offset
PracticumOffset.description: Offset into the scoped list. Advance by received item count until an empty page.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Exact configured application origin, forwarded by the same-origin identity proxy.

CSRFToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CSRFToken.description: Must match the host-only algohub_csrf cookie and the server-side session hash.

RequestID.description: Correlation identifier for API responses, structured logs and audits.

PracticumScope.description: Concrete Practicum scope; omitted/empty fields are unrestricted only within the actor grant. No wildcard values.

PracticumActivationScope.description: Must be contained in the session and actor grant; session_id must match the path.

PracticumPublicQuestion.description: Frozen public question. Private grading rules, course_id and authoring version are deliberately absent.

PracticumQuestion.description: Private authoring/review only. Empty reference_answer is omitted. Rubric criterion IDs are unique and max_score sums to question points.

PracticumActivation.description: Student summary; no roster, selected IDs, access token, token hash or grading rules.

PracticumAdminActivation.description: Immutable activation roster and selected question IDs. Empty entry_approved_ids is omitted. Access tokens are never returned on reads or close.

PracticumCreatedActivation.description: Plain access_token appears only on the first successful token-required creation. Idempotent replay returns current state WITHOUT the token; securely retain the original creation value.

PracticumAnswer.description: Score/feedback appear only in authorized manual review or a published grade; omitted before publication for students.

PracticumAttempt.description: Authoritative current attempt; score and percentage are null until manually published. max_score is known immediately. Server time controls deadlines, not client wall time. Submission is terminal for answers.

PracticumGradingJob.description: Private job summary; lease credential is never exposed. Suggestions do not publish grades.

PracticumAttemptReview.description: Requires practicum.grade.write in the full activation scope. Private immutable questions and draft grades are separate from the public attempt questions.

can_open.description: Terminal owned work remains readable after assignment changes; active work still requires current eligibility.

PracticumRunResult.description: Execution outcome, not a grade. Compile/runtime/timeout/provider failures may be HTTP 200 with this status. Output is bounded and normalized. request_id identifies the persisted run and remains stable on replay; it is distinct from envelope HTTP request_id.

PracticumSessionCreateRequest.description: Do not set session_id in scope; the API generates it.

PracticumSessionUpdateRequest.description: Full mutable field replacement, not a sparse patch. Scope is immutable.

PracticumCourseUpdateRequest.description: Full mutable field replacement; session_id and kind are immutable. Existing activation snapshots do not change.

PracticumQuestionCreateRequest.description: Coding requires nonempty language. Rubric IDs must be unique and max_score must sum to points. UTF-8 encoded normalized question input is limited to 32 KiB; activation question snapshots together to 512 KiB.

PracticumQuestionUpdateRequest.description: Full editable question fields plus version. Omitted course_id retains its value; moving to a different course is forbidden. Changes do not alter existing activation snapshots. Rubric IDs unique, scores sum to points; normalized input <=32 KiB.

PracticumActivationCreateRequest.description: Roster IDs must be existing active scoped mahasiswa. Entry-approved IDs must be a subset of the roster; ujian_praktik start requires approval. closes_at, if supplied, is future and <=366 days away. Shared timer starts once at first start; individual starts per student. Both are bounded by closes_at.

PracticumAnswerInput.description: Question IDs are unique in a batch and belong to the frozen attempt. Essay language must be empty; coding language defaults to the frozen question language and cannot change it.

PracticumAnswersRequest.description: Whole-attempt optimistic revision; one successful batch increments it once. Total saved answer content <=256 KiB, individual value <=64 KiB UTF-8. Autosave never creates an attempt.

PracticumEmptyRequest.description: Send the empty JSON object, not an empty body.

PracticumRunRequest.description: Coding question in an open owned attempt. Select exact language/version from runner metadata. stdin defaults to empty. No host execution or browser-to-provider traffic.

PracticumBulkGradeRequest.description: Atomically enqueue 1..25 distinct submitted attempts, all in scope; one invalid entry rejects the whole batch.

PracticumManualGradeRequest.description: Exactly one grade per frozen question, score <=question points. Reason must not be whitespace. Optimistic grade_revision prevents overwrites. publish=false retains an unpublished draft; publish=true publishes raw sum and percentage. Published grades cannot be unpublished; subsequent audited corrections remain published. Manual changes supersede in-flight provider suggestions.

source.description: Opaque UTF-8 source. The provider preview never receives credentials.

browser_test_passed.description: Completion-only client assertion for E-learning gamification; not authoritative academic evidence.

lesson_version.description: Completion-only public lesson version bound to the browser testcase result.

PracticumConflict.description: 409 CONFLICT: stale definition version, answer revision, grade_revision, idempotency input mismatch, duplicate course kind or in-flight run. ATTEMPT_CLOSED: terminal activation/attempt rejects new changes.

PracticumBodyTooLarge.description: 413 BODY_TOO_LARGE: Practicum request body exceeds 256 KiB (identity remains 64 KiB). Smaller per-field/normalized input limits return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR.

PracticumRateLimited.description: 429 RATE_LIMITED or RUNNER_QUOTA_EXCEEDED. Runner uses durable concurrency and 30 admissions per user/activation/minute. Retry-After is seconds; runner quota uses 30.

PracticumUnavailable.description: 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE for disabled/unconfigured Practicum, or PRACTICUM_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE for an unavailable runner. Do not assume a real provider is configured.

Login.description: Session established or rotated; opaque credentials are only in Set-Cookie headers

Set-Cookie.description: Host-only session and CSRF cookies; Max-Age never exceeds the server deadline

Logout.description: SSO family revoked and current cookies cleared

Permissions.description: Caller-owned active assignments and effective grants

Audit.description: Scoped audit page and scan cursor

Unauthenticated.description: No valid session, invalid credential, expired/replayed code, or host mismatch

Forbidden.description: Role, permission, scope, account state, origin or CSRF denied

NotFound.description: Resource missing or deliberately hidden from the caller

Conflict.description: Stale access version or duplicate identity key

ValidationError.description: Invalid fields, unsafe redirect, scope expansion or prohibited self-edit

InternalError.description: Sanitized internal failure; required audit mutations are rolled back

Unavailable.description: Database, identity provider or configuration unavailable
